usage: xo symbols [--dir=DIR] [--pub] [--json|--text] [DIR | FILE.xo]
       xo symbols --file=FILE.xo | --module=PATH [--pub]

The declarations of one directory's own files, private ones too; --pub
lists the exported surface only. At a root with no .xo files of its
own, the directories below that have them are named. --file (or a .xo
argument) lists one file's; --module one module's by its import path,
std and runtime ones too (std/json, native/llrt/pool).

Output is text at a terminal and JSON otherwise; --json or --text
chooses. Exit status: 0 with an answer, 1 for no match, 2 for a usage
error.
